zh.title: 多日日月升落窗口
zh.summary: 在多日总览规划日出、日落、月升和月落。

items.text: 新增日出、月升和月落目标窗口。日月升落均取事件前后各一小时。7 天总览在窗口缺少预报时次时，可标注距事件不超过 90 分钟的最近一笔作为参考。点按起始日期即可打开日历。

en.title: Multi-day Sun and Moon rise/set windows
en.summary: Plan sunrise, sunset, moonrise and moonset in the multi-day overview.

items.text: Added sunrise, moonrise and moonset targets. All Sun and Moon rise/set windows span an hour on either side. If the 7-day overview has no sample in a window, it can label the nearest forecast up to 90 minutes from the event as a reference. Select the start date to open the calendar.
